name: hono
_note: The published Hono tarball contains dist but omits its Vitest sources. The complete 120-file src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} inventory is verified by path hash at the matching immutable tag. The first adapter executes every callback in two synchronous utility files against the published dist bytes; all other files remain explicitly deferred rather than silently absent. registrationSites is a measured count of test()/it() call sites, not a claim about test.each expansion.
